title: El desierto costero y la corriente de Humboldt
goal: Explore the marine geography of the Humboldt Current, upwelling ecology, and coastal hyper-aridity.
grammar: oceanografía de la corriente de Humboldt, afloramiento marino y clima desértico costero

items: Analyze the physical upwelling mechanism of deep nutrient-rich Antarctic waters.
Examine the role of the thermal inversion layer in generating the Lima winter garúa.
Deploy marine biology, fishery, and climatic vocabulary (afloramiento, garúa, anchoveta, biomasa).
